name: Everbloom
description: 开发可洗涤、可生物降解的新型纤维renoa，将羊绒、羊毛和羽绒废料通过AI材料科学模型转化为类羊绒替代纤维，已获美国联邦贸易委员会批准为25年来首个新纤维分类
description_en: Develops washable, biodegradable fiber renoa, converting cashmere, wool, and feather waste into cashmere-like substitute fiber using AI material science models, approved by U.S. FTC as the first new fiber classification in 25 years
why_matters: 利用自研AI材料科学模型突破传统纺织品限制，将废弃蛋白转化为可机洗、不起球、不缩水的高端纤维替代品，解决羊绒环境破坏问题的同时降低成本，预计2027年第二季度首批产品上市
why_matters_en: Uses proprietary AI material science model to overcome traditional textile limitations, transforming waste protein into machine-washable, pill-resistant, shrink-proof premium fiber substitute that addresses cashmere's environmental damage while reducing costs, with first products expected Q2 2027
latest_news: 2026年10月获美国联邦贸易委员会批准renoa为新纤维分类，正与多家公司合作将renoa以20%混纺比例用于羊绒产品，首批商业产品预计2027年第二季度上市
latest_news_en: In October 2026, renoa was approved by U.S. FTC as a new fiber classification; currently working with multiple companies to incorporate renoa at 20% blend ratio in cashmere products, with first commercial products expected Q2 2027
source_title: Here’s what ‘renoa’ — the first new fiber in 25 years — feels like

evidence.quote: Renoa was recently approved as the first new fiber classification in 25 years by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission
The startup developed its own AI model for material science, and a cashmere substitute is the first product
